metadata.title: Lindon Gao / Dyna: Fog, Disagreement, and Full-Stack Robotics

conclusion: Zhang Xiaojun has Lindon Gao on a 171-minute Dyna tape. US labs bet the brain; China bets the supply chain. Dyna calls itself full-stack proto-research. Lindon: China-born, US at 11, game shop at 14, NYU medicine then Stern, banking, then Caber in the 2017 Amazon-Go year — 150 VCs, a hundred-plus nos, 'we are cockroaches,' ~six years and a ~¥350 million mark. Team split: 落地 versus research. He says a useful robot does not need general intelligence. Physical Intelligence is the AGI foil; Amazon Go is the 2017 foil.
background: E154, Oct 15, 171 minutes. Lindon visits Shanghai ~once or twice a year (local team). Both sides of the Pacific feel noisy: releases, raises, no convergence. Meditations / Wang Yangming sit in the title; the audible file is identity — 落地 versus research — and the cockroach raise after Caber. Physical Intelligence is the AGI foil; Amazon Go is the 2017 foil. Quotes below are the audible strings.
important_facts: Route: brain-only (US) versus body-only (China) on a 171-minute tape. Dyna refuses the split. Proto-research means the map is fog and you still ship a stack. Identity crisis on the tape: half the team wanted落地, half wanted research. Lindon's line: smelling money is survival; the dream is open sea. He will not call those a fight. Shanghai and the Valley both feel 浮躁 — every lab dropping a clip and raising.

Founder clock: 14-year-old game market, sold the site. Parents let him drop NYU medicine after two years for Stern, then IB because everyone wanted IB (~2 years), then Caber — unmanned retail in 2017 when Amazon Go made fifty-plus clones. He says they were among the few left. 150 meetings that year; later 60-plus investors; a hundred-plus nos; ~six years; ~¥10 million-class checks and a 3.5亿 figure on the tape. Cockroach is the internal name. 2021 is when the next turn becomes visible on the file.

Product: most people equate a general robot with Physical Intelligence being 'solved.' Lindon: product definition — a robot can be useful before intelligence is general. Diligence Dyna as a long fog, not a 2026 humanoid print. PI is the foil, not a customer. Do not mark AMZN on one Shanghai visit. He was 14 on the first game-account shop, two years in NYU medicine, then Stern and about two years of banking before Caber. Amazon Go in 2017 spawned fifty-plus clones; he says they were among the few left. Later 60-plus investors and a 千万-class check sit next to the 3.5亿 mark. 2021 is when the next turn becomes visible. Shanghai once or twice a year is the local-team cadence, not a China-pivot.

mental_model.name: Full-Stack Fog × Cockroach Raise × Useful Before AGI
mental_model.components: Refuse US-brain / China-body. Keep research and落地 in one identity. Survive a hundred nos (2017 retail → Dyna). Useful beats general. Tesla and PI are the two compares: one stack, one brain-max. The identity fight is the long part of the 171 minutes: half the team wanted落地, half wanted research, and Lindon will not call money-scent and star-sea a split. Both Shanghai and the Valley feel noisy — clips and raises, no convergence. Caber in 2017 was the Amazon-Go copycat year with 150 meetings and a hundred-plus nos; cockroach is the internal name that survived ~six years and a 3.5亿-class mark. Product definition is the punchline: a robot can be useful before intelligence is general. Physical Intelligence is the foil that waits for AGI in the body; Amazon Go is the foil that already shipped a store.
mental_model.application: Private:Dyna is a fog-route private. PI is the general-intelligence foil. AMZN is the 2017 Go / Caber foil. Do not buy a 2026 robot week.

key_insights.question: Brain or body?
key_insights.answer: US waits on the body; China waits on the brain. Dyna wants both. That split is the identity fight.

key_insights.question: What did Caber teach?
key_insights.answer: 2017 Amazon-Go clones. 150 VCs. Six years. ¥350 million-class mark. Same refusal muscle.

key_insights.question: What about Physical Intelligence?
key_insights.answer: He will not wait for AGI in the body. Tesla is the other stack that agrees.

top_investment_implications.thesis: Full-stack fog after a hundred-nos retail life; not a 2026 humanoid print — low
Amazon Go year is the Caber foil on this tape, not a robot multiple — low
